useTabs.description: Whether to indent with tabs instead of spaces. Multi-line strings are still indented with spaces, since Nix keeps leading tabs in them.

indentWidth.description: The number of spaces for an indent when not using tabs. Alejandra only supports 2 and 4.

newLineKind.description: The kind of newline to use.

oneOf.description: For each file, uses the newline kind found at the end of the last line.

spaceAroundBrackets.description: Whether to put spaces inside the brackets of single-line lists and attribute sets (ex. `{ a = 1; }` and `[ 1 2 ]`). Experimental in Alejandra.
